name: orsc-pop-v3
spoken: لعبة POPUCOM تصل إلى PS5 يوم الثلاثاء 17 نوفمبر، وهي متوفرة على PC وNintendo Switch. من هايبرغريف (Hypergryph) مطوّر لعبة Arknights، مغامرة تلعبها مع أصدقائك، وتحلّ ألغازها بتبديل الألوان.
headline:
لعبة POPUCOM
تصل إلى PS5
label: رسمي

angle.hook: the co-op puzzle platformer from Hypergryph, the studio behind Arknights, reaches PS5 on Tuesday 17 Nov
angle.why_now: dated PS5 launch on Tue 17 Nov 2026, the day after the slot (announced 3 Nov with Fireshine Games' 'POPUCOM | PS5 Launch Date Trailer'); no Arabic outlet checked has carried it (git grep, digests)
angle.what_it_means_here: PS5 players in the region get a colourful co-op game for up to four players that was on PC and Nintendo Switch only; Steam price in the UAE in the caption
angle.payoff: the world's vehicles: the yellow submarine, the flying bus the heroes board, the balloon bus over the sea

story_type_items.OUT NOW (release dated): platforms: PS5 on 17 Nov 2026 (Fireshine Games trailer title and Gematsu/Final Weapon reports of the announcement); already out on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, 1 Jun 2025) and Nintendo Switch (4 Dec 2025, Gematsu); AED price: Steam store in the UAE (caption), PS5 price in the region not read, not stated; what it is: a co-op puzzle platformer for up to four players where colour switching solves puzzles (GRYPHLINE overview via Gematsu, Steam page)

sensitive: none: E10+ cartoon game; shots chosen without characters aiming or firing their gel blasters at anyone (the pink-girl ball shot and the boss fights left out)
decision_log: sources: two official Steam trailers of app 2543180 fetched as the server fetches them (ffmpeg -ss 0 on the HLS master, -c copy): 'release PV' (1920x1080 30 fps 5.4 Mbps, 95.0 s, video starts 3.02 s) and 'Trailer' (the 2023 announcement trailer, 1920x1080 30 fps 5.3 Mbps, 110.8 s). Scene cuts measured on that seek timeline; the PS5 Launch Date Trailer is on YouTube only (no yt-dlp)

0-3.3 headline over the fluffy blue birds under the orange tree (PV 8.6, after the GRYPHLINE slate, whose frozen stretch the prerender read to 8.41): moving, the game's colours, headline over the tree, birds below it

line 1 (studio) over the heroes: the orange-haired girl close (TR 13.25), skydiving (TR 18.67, ends before the cut at 19.68), past the yellow creature (TR 19.75), the blue hero landing and posing as the orange friend leaps in (TR 25.38): illustration (v1 prerender: «من استوديو هايبرغريف (Hypergryph)» ran out of the safe zone, so «استوديو» dropped)

line 2 (with friends) over the blue hero walking on with the orange friend (TR 27.55, ends before he raises his arm blaster) and the flying bus pulling in as the heroes run aboard (TR 80.40): co-op shown; v1's grass shot (players holding gel blasters under the bubble robot) dropped so no blaster is gripped on screen, and the heroes-among-the-gold shot rejected (one of the two is always half cut at a 9:16 edge)
line 3 (colour puzzles) over the colour-block puzzle machine (PV 39.1, 39.95): demonstration

after line 3 the picture breathes with the strip pinned (date; PC and Nintendo Switch): the yellow submarine (PV 66.36, 0.9 s: the v2 Reel showed it drifting out of the right edge after 0.95 s) and the balloon bus over the sea (TR 84.65); the last 2 s are the balloon bus, a picture
strip (split): الموعد · الثلاثاء 17 نوفمبر | متوفرة على · PC · Nintendo Switch; the headline carries PS5, the strip the date and the other platforms, the lines never repeat them

sound: the announcement trailer's own music from 23.80 s (seek timeline), music_only; faster-whisper small on both trailers hears no speech (only 'I'/'You' hallucinations at no_speech 0.3 to 0.74); RMS -14 to -17 dB steady from 8 to 96 s, so the music runs past the end card
credit: one entry 0 to 10 «المصدر: هايبرغريف (Hypergryph)», the developer whose logo opens the trailers
